programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan, Canada is home to tunnels that sprawl underneath most of the city's downtown; while much of the system has been converted into a tourist attraction, some residue of the spirit realm still clings onto the space; the guys talk with a local psychic medium who corroborates the paranormal stories that some employees have experienced and gives clues as to where to look in the tunnel system; a sensory deprivation session in the catacombs leads to a experience that defies logic.

programs.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programs.sub_title: Etruscan Gold Teeth, Soutra Aisle, The Two Toes
programs.desc: Ancient clues reveal bold dentistry, hospital secrets, and an arcane prosthetic.

programs.title: Cursed Histories
programs.sub_title: Abandon All Hope Diamond, The Bard's Warning, Cursed Pebbles Of Koh Hin
programs.desc: The Hope diamond makes its way across the world; William Shakespeare's remains are at the center of centuries-old rumors; a god enacts consequences on those who dare to steal from the island he shaped centuries ago.

programs.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programs.sub_title: Rivers of Mercury, Ethics of Anatomy, The Black Death
programs.desc: Learn about China's immortal emperor, a rebel scholar and the Black Death.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: A team of experts breaks down significant disasters in history, including the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, the Suez Canal blockage, the California wildfires of 2020, the 1970 Yungay, Peru, avalanche, and the bombings of Hiroshima.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Cameras capture an entire city floating in the sky; a signal comes from under a tiny island off the coast of Africa; a powerful radio beam from deep space reaches Earth only to vanish and never return.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: After an eleven-year estrangement, Jordan and his father, Adonis, have recently reconnected; for the first time, they'll travel to Adonis' home country of Cuba for Jordan to discover their family's rich musical legacy.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A diplomat with a critical heart condition dies and is transported to another planet; a woman suffers a fatal miscarriage and finds herself meeting familiar spirits in the afterlife, only to come back to her physical body.

programs.title: Engineering Evolved
programs.desc: Journeying through a labyrinth of microchips and motors to see how some of the world's first combustion engines on wheels transformed into slick and sophisticated self-driving vehicles.

programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: Speed is a major competitive strategy; while humans measure and focus on how to achieve it in greater quantities, Earth's creatures have adapted and evolved over long periods to achieve acceleration.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Tiny cosmic rays travel through the universe, constantly bombarding Earth with a stream of extreme radiation; scientists study these high-energy particles to understand their galactic origins.

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: The Ramessides rise to become some of the most powerful pharaohs in Egyptian history; but, a civil war ignited by a power vacuum threatens to destabilize an empire.
